usage: llm-modelbench report [-h] [--run-id RUN_ID] [--out OUT]
                             [--weights WEIGHTS] [--report-out REPORT_OUT]
                             [--mock]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --run-id RUN_ID
  --out OUT             run directory (if not using --run-id)
  --weights WEIGHTS     report-time category overrides, e.g.
                        coding_python=0.4,agentic_tool=0.3
  --report-out REPORT_OUT
                        separate output directory for --weights; defaults to a
                        sibling override copy
  --mock
